AI & automation

Maxinsights raises $30M and introduces MaxLoop and MaxGlove

It reports 1.5 million model-ready hours from over 2 million captured hours; its million-hour force-data goal is for 2027.

Business Wire via MarketMinute ↗22 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryVideos 1

Capturing everyday work

Maxinsights announced a $30 million seed round led by Peak XV on October 22. It pays over 5,000 collectors to record real tasks such as cooking and cleaning, reporting more than 2 million captured hours, including 1.5 million model-ready hours. These are company figures.

Quality checks and contact data

MaxLoop scores incoming recordings and feeds guidance back to collectors. MaxGlove, developed with Genesis AI, captures touch and force, including grip and object-weight information that video alone cannot reveal.

Separating inventory from targets

One million hours of force data in 2027 is a target, not delivered inventory. Data volume does not establish better robot success rates. This report uses the accessible Business Wire syndication on MarketMinute; the direct Business Wire page could not be inspected during this run.
